name: KDE Plasma & Desktop Control
description: Controls applications, windows, notifications, and clipboard in KDE Plasma over D-Bus, with AT-SPI2 fallback for legacy GUIs.

tools.name: launch_application
tools.description: Launch an installed desktop application by desktop entry ID.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Display a desktop notification via org.freedesktop.Notifications.

tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: List open windows and active workspace state via KWin D-Bus.
